notes.title: New Maps!
notes.notes:
It has been almost 2 years since the last update but im back! 
This update includes 4 new maps, more color options for the UI and some more settings.

I hope you have fun playing!

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: There were some bugs with the 50, 100, 500 etc. mine acchievments; they should work as intended now.

notes.title: Optimization
notes.notes:
Some maps had performance problems which should be fixed now.
Also i did some slight colorgrading.

notes.title: Custumizable UI!
notes.notes: You can now change the look of your game by changing the color of the UI.
